introHtml: Plastic sun visor clips offer a lightweight, durable solution for keeping essentials within easy reach while driving. Unlike metal alternatives, they resist rust and won't scratch vehicle interiors. Perfect for giveaway items like the Munch-It™ Clip or Magnetic Rip 'n' Clip Bag Clip, these clips can be imprinted with your logo using pad printing or debossing. Ideal for safety managers and marketing directors seeking cost-effective, practical promotional products for commuters and road warriors.
